name: Toggle
idea: Ink trail. The knob stretches when you press it, overshoots a little, and leaves the colour behind it as it travels.

name: Checkbox
idea: Pen stroke. The box squeezes when pressed and springs back filled. Then the check is drawn in, the way you would write it.

name: Button
idea: Fold to a pulse. The button folds into a circle while it works, then opens back up. A check means saved. A shake means it failed.
extra: <label class="demo-opt"><input type="checkbox" id="fail-next"> Make the next save fail</label>

name: Tabs
idea: Inchworm. The underline's leading edge leaves first and the trailing edge follows. The panel slides in from the side you moved toward.

name: Tooltip
idea: One tooltip that travels. The first one waits half a second. After that, the same bubble glides straight to the next button with no wait.

name: Toast stack
idea: A deck you can read. New toasts land on top of the stack. Hover or focus fans them out and pauses every timer. Each toast shows its time running out, and you can swipe one away.

name: Slider
idea: A bubble with weight. The value bubble leans back against the way you drag, like something carried, and settles upright when you stop.

name: Text field
idea: A head-shake for no. If you type a character the field can't take, it refuses it on the spot. The field gives a small dampened shake and the rule below turns red.

name: Accordion
idea: Unfold. The panel opens on a grid track, then its lines arrive top to bottom, 45ms apart. The plus lies down into a minus.

name: Stepper
idea: Odometer. Only the digits that change roll: up for more, down for less. At the limit, the number bumps against the wall instead of the button going dead.
